Name: CatDad's Seasonal Cute Characters for Soli Revived
Author: caatdaad
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420087-1319754898.png[/img][/center]


If you're like me, you prefer having your characters in Poltergeister's SCA style. This mod aims to bring that style to Soli Revived as well. I really hope you enjoy my work! Happy Halloween!!!


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420046-853231980.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]Download the mod.[/*]
[*]Unzip.[/*]
[*]Put it in your mod folder.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420130-1194512906.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*]5 seasonal sprites and portraits. His pauldrons will change color with the seasons! And a bonus outfit in the rain. [b]Keep in mind Ginger Island is always in summer. He will keep his yellow pauldrons there until you either marry him, or turn off seasonal outfits in the config.[/b][/*]
[*]The portraits are edited (with permission) from LavenderSkelly's own portrait mod for Soli, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50141]Sun bleached Soli[/url]. Check this one out if you don't want to use my sprites![/*]
[*]The sprites were drawn with the intent to keep Soli's appearance more in line with the rest of the skeletons in the game.[/*]
[*]This mod is modular! If you'd like updated portraits and sprites, but don't care for the seasonal outfits, you can turn that off. He'll just use the purple pauldrons like in the original mod.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420163-1780796483.png[/img]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45526]Soli Revived[/url][/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54850/54850-1793420197-1700623308.png[/img][/center]
